item.description: The US and Iran have agreed to end the war, with the Strait of Hormuz set to reopen late this week. Oil prices have already started to ease.

item.description: Socceroos beat Turkiye 2-0 at the FIFA World Cup and Hamilton won for Ferrari in Barcelona. NRL State of Origin Game 2 is Wednesday at the MCG.

item.description: Sunday is the winter solstice, the shortest day and longest night. Days get longer from here, a positive surely?

item.title: Reminder: Don't Throw Out Kitchen Cutlery
item.description: Stainless-steel cutlery must never be thrown out. Wash it or place it in the dishwasher so it can be used by all staff. Please follow kitchen etiquette.

item.title: Wellness Corner: Practice Gratitude
item.description: This week's wellness tip: practice gratitude each day, when you wake, before bed, or at lunch, for the physical and mental health benefits.
